Nina (People Ops): Heads up — external auditor asked us to pull forward the SOC2/annual privacy intake. New ingestion cutoff is Tue 03/22 16:00 PT. Please see required naming + quick FAQ below.

Caleb (Security): Which controls are the auditors prioritizing this cycle? We should flag those first.

Marta (Compliance): High priority: Access controls, Change control (deploy approvals), Data retention policies, Vendor intake, and Incident response tabletop minutes. If you have more than one artifact for a control, upload both and mark the primary in the form.

Iris (Eng): For change control, we have a ticket + merged PR + CD log. Do we want all three packed or the PR + deploy log is sufficient?

Caleb (Security): PR + deploy log is sufficient. If the ticket contains approvals (e.g., security signoff), include it. Zip as `20260322_eng_change_control.zip` and include README.txt listing contents.

Nina (People Ops): Naming convention (must match exactly for automation):
`<YYYYMMDD>_<team>_<control_shortname>.<ext>`
Examples: `20260322_prod_incident_tabletop.pdf`, `20260322_eng_access_export.csv`, `20260322_legal_vendor_packet.pdf`.

Jon (Prod): If a dashboard only shows relative times, can we include a log export?

Caleb (Security): Yes — prefer an export with absolute timestamps. If not possible, include a screenshot plus an exported query and the run timestamp in README.

Iris (Eng): We have contractors with shadow access via a vendor portal. Can the vendor portal audit be used?

Marta (Compliance): Acceptable if a sponsor (full-time) attests in the upload form and you include a sponsor sign-off email. Use the "contractor exception" checkbox in the form.

evidence_bot: Reminder queued — "SOC2 & Privacy evidence due Tue 03/22 16:00 PT". It will post in #people-ops at 08:00 PT on due day and DM listed owners.

Nina (People Ops): Office hours: Mon 09:30-10:30 PT (quick triage), Tue 13:00-15:00 PT (last-minute checks). Calendar links: https://go.redwood.company/compliance-office-hours.

Caleb (Security): Important: redact PII before uploading. If redaction is performed, include a one-line note describing redacted fields.

Jon (Prod): Will the ingestion pipeline accept nested zip structures?

Marta (Compliance): No — flat zip only. Put all files at the root of your zip; README must be at root too. Otherwise ingestion will fail.

Iris (Eng): I'll assemble eng bundle Mon EOD. Thanks for the clarity.

Nina (People Ops): If you miss the hard cut we'll accept items but they become an "exception" and require extra reviewer time. Please aim for the deadline. Ping me or #compliance-help for urgent issues. :pray:
